candidate_relationship_description: Member State competent authority (R) - group auditor (I candidate) - undertaking/group (T)
adjudication_note: All five relational-test conditions met: identifiable R (competent authority), identifiable T (undertaking), analytically distinct third actor (group auditor), mediating function (assurance of sustainability reporting), explicit textual support (Art. 27a(1)(a)).

candidate_actor: subsidiary-level assurance provider (independent assurance services provider / third-country auditor / statutory auditor / audit entity / audit firm)
candidate_relationship_description: group auditor (R, in a coordinating/reviewing capacity) - subsidiary-level assurance provider (I candidate) - subsidiary undertaking (T)
adjudication_note: Downstream link in the same chain as CAND-01 (chain_id=CHAIN-CSRD-1, level L2). Coded as ONE relationship because Art. 27a(1)(b) lists the eligible entity types disjunctively (any ONE of them fills the same functional role in a given case), not as five simultaneous actors in one relationship - see actor ACT-04 note.

candidate_relationship_description: Member State (R, transposing the obligation) - undertaking (T): direct duty to include sustainability information in the management report
exclusion_reason: Fails condition (c) of the relational test: no analytically distinct third actor performs a mediating function in this specific provision. Dyadic R-T relationship (reporting_mechanism_present=1, intermediary_present=0).
adjudication_note: Deliberate negative control: reporting exists without an intermediary here. The intermediary (auditor) only appears in the separate assurance provisions coded as CAND-01/CAND-02.

candidate_relationship_description: European Commission (R) - competent body (I candidate) - operator/applicant (T)
adjudication_note: All conditions met: competent body assesses applications, verifies conformity, assigns registration numbers, contracts terms of use - distinct mediating function between Commission's framework (Art. 8) and the applicant.

adjudication_note: Split from a single sentence naming two distinct accredited-body types (testing vs. verification) performing two distinct functions - one-row-one-relationship rule applied (see CAND-05b).

candidate_relationship_description: competent body (R, relying party) - EN 45011-accredited verification body (I candidate) - operator's product/verification outcome (T)
adjudication_note: Paired with CAND-05a; same chain (CHAIN-ECO-1, level L2), distinct function (verification, not testing).

candidate_relationship_description: European Commission (R) - EUEB (candidate I) - no target identified
exclusion_reason: Fails condition (b)/(d): no rule-taker/target is mediated by this body. The EUEB advises the Commission on rule-making (criteria-setting) itself; it does not sit between an existing regulator-target relationship.
adjudication_note: Deliberate negative control demonstrating discriminant validity: not every third actor near a regulator is an intermediary.

inclusion_decision: quarantined - not promoted to rit_relationships_v3.csv pending resolution
exclusion_reason: Condition (a) not demonstrable from this provision alone (R not named); condition (e)/target identity ambiguous (dual/indirect T). Held in quarantine per RIT_CODEBOOK_v3.md rather than force-included or force-excluded.
adjudication_note: Open construct-validity question for discussion with David: regulated index provider vs. regulatory intermediary performing ranking/rating. Kept here, not in rit_relationships_v3.csv, until resolved.

candidate_relationship_description: competent authority (R) - verifier (I candidate) - operator/aircraft operator (T)
adjudication_note: Strongest textual support in the sample: Art. 27(3)(j) names operator, competent authority and verifier as the three responsibility-holders in the same sentence.

candidate_actor: national accreditation body (as intermediary between the Art. 14 peer-evaluation framework and the verifier)
candidate_relationship_description: body recognised under Art. 14 of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008 (R, peer-evaluates national accreditation bodies) - national accreditation body (I candidate) - verifier (T)
adjudication_note: First reading treated this as a direct national-accreditation-body-to-verifier duty (dyadic, no I) - corrected on the relational test: the national accreditation body is itself subject to peer evaluation by the Art. 14 body (evidence already on file in CODEBOOK.md's certification anchor examples), so it occupies I here, not R. This also produces the role-multiplicity case: the verifier (ACT-16) is I in RIT-006 and T in RIT-007; the national accreditation body (ACT-18) is I here and could itself be coded as T in a further relationship with ACT-19 as R, not done in this pilot.
